# BahatiBox project notes

- This project is a static website made with semantic HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript. Do not add React, Next.js, Tailwind or a client framework.
- Keep pages mobile-first, accessible, responsive, and lightweight for Kenyan mobile networks.
- Currency is Kenyan shillings (KES); mask participant names in public views.
- Treat raffle counts, winners, dashboard figures and payment flows as demo data unless connected to trusted server-side services.
- Never claim a payment, seller verification, random draw, payout, or refund occurred without a verified backend result.
- There is no secure authentication or database connection in this static demo. Validate authorization, payment callbacks, idempotency, auditability, privacy, and Kenyan legal requirements before production.
